tgt: Ms Sylvia Ncediwe Mdunyelwa, the jazz singer and actor, who worked with the late Victor Ntoni and the Ngcukana brothers, Winston Mankuku, Nick Carter and Merton Barrow.

src: Kopanokakaretšo ya Ditšhabakopano (UNGA).
tgt: Imiba enguNdaba-mlonyeniINdibano yeZizwe eziManyeneyo (i-UNGA).

src: Kabinete e amogetše polelo ka Mopresidente Cyril Ramaphosa yeo a e filego kopanong ya bo 78 ya UNGA yeo e bego e swaretšwe New York ka United States of America go tloga ka la 18 go fihla ka la 26 Lewedi 2023.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamkele intetho kaMongameli u-Cyril Ramaphosa kwi-UNGA yama-78 nebibanjelwe e-New York, e-United States of America ukusuka ngomhla we-18 ukuya kowama-26 kweyoMsintsi ngowama-2023.

src: Polelo ye ya Mopresidente yeo e amogetšwego ka bontšhi e gateletše ka leswa maemo a Afrika Borwa ka tabeng ya go thekga ka maatla dikgahlegelo, le kgathotema yeo e lekalekanago ebile e kwagalago ya kontinete ya Afrika mmogo le dinaga tšeo di hlabologago ka kakaretšo go UN le diforamong tše dingwe tša mebušo ya dinaga.
tgt: Intetho kaMongameli eyamkelwe ngokubanzi iphinde yaqinisekisa kwakhona isikhundla soMzantsi Afrika ekukhuthazeni umdla, kunye nasekuthatheni inxaxheba okulinganayo kwaye okunentsingiselo kwelizwekazi i-Afrika kunye namazwe akwi-Global South jikelele kwi-UN kunye nakwezinye iiforam zamazwe ngamazwe.

src: Polelo ye e ile ya gatelela gape le boematia bja Afrika Borwa ka hlohleletšong ya thekgo bakeng sa: boikgafo bjo bo mpshafaditšwego go dikamano tša mebušo ya dinaga, bjoo bo itheilego go melao yeo e hlakilego ebile bo thekgilwe ke ditheo tšeo di phethagetšego.
tgt: Le ntetho ikwaphinde yaqinisekise ukuzinza koMzantsi Afrika ekuhlanganiseni inkxaso:a) ukuzinikela ngokutsha kumanyano lwamazwe ngamazwe, olusekwe kwimithetho ecacileyo kwaye exhaswa ngamaziko asebenzayo.

src: phetošo ya Lekgotla la Thireletšo la UN (UNSC) go dira gore kokwane ya tekatekano ya boipušo e kwagale, gape le go kgontšha UNSC go arabela dinnete tša seabe sa tikologo go dipolotiki ka moo go phethagetšego.
tgt: b) uhlaziyo lweBhunga lezoKhuseleko le-UN (i-UNSC), ukunika intsingiselo kumthetho-siseko wokulingana kwezizwe ezizimeleyo kunye nokwenza ukuba i-UNSC iphendule ngempumelelo kwizinto ezenzekayo ngoku kwiipolitiki zelizwe.

src: ditšhaba tšeo di humilego gore di oketše thekgo ya mašeleng go phethagatšeng Lenaneo la Tlhabollo yeo e Swarelelago la 2023 le go fihlelela dinepo tša phetogo ya klaemete ka mokgwa woo o nago le dintlha ka moka ebile e kopantšwego, go balwa le tlhokego ya go tsenya tirišong Sekhwama sa Tobo le Tshenyo bakeng sa dinaga tšeo di sa bolokegago tšeo di amilwego gampe ke masetlapelo a klaemete, bjalo ka ge go dumelelanwe Sešeneng ya bo 27 ya Khonferense ya Dinaga le Mekgatlo yeo e bego e swaretšwe go la Egypt ka Dibatsela 2022.
tgt: c) izizwe ezityebileyo mazandise inkxaso mali ukuze kuphunyezwe i-Ajenda yama-2030 yoPhuhliso oluZinzileyo kunye nokufezekisa iinjongo zabo zokutshintsha kwemozulu ngendlela ebanzi kwaye edibeneyo, kubandakanywa nesidingo sokusebenza ngokukhawuleza kwengxowa-mali i-Loss and Damage Fund yamazwe asemngciphekweni wokuhlaselwa kakhulu yintlekele yemozulu, njengoko kwakuvunyelwene kwiSeshini yama-27 yeNkomfa yamaQela neyayibanjelwe e-Egypt ngeyeNkanga wama-2022.

src: Mopresidente Ramaphosa o gateletše leswa boikgafo bja Afrika Borwa bja go tšwela pele go šogana le taba ya phetogo ya klaemete le go aga maemong a go ba moetapele ka go enetši ya go tšweletšwa ka dilo tša tlhago, haetrotšene ya go hlolwa ka go aroganywa ga meetse le oksetšene, le phetolelaindasetering yeo e swarelelago.
tgt: UMongameli Ramaphosa ukuqinisekisile ukuzinikela koMzantsi Afrika ekuqhubekeni kujongana nokutshintsha kwemozulu kunye nokubeka eli lizwe njengenkokeli kumandla ahlaziyekayo, i-hydrogen eluhlaza kunye noshishino oluzinzileyo.

src: Mopresidente Ramaphosa o file polelo gape le Samiting ya Kaonafatšo ya Thibelo, Boitokišetšo le Karabelo go Mauba, a le maemong a gagwe bjalo ka Molwedi wa Yunione ya Afrika ge go etla Karabelong ya Bolwetši bja Kokwanahloko ya Khorona (COVID-19)2.
tgt: UMongameli Ramaphosa ukwathethe kwiNgqungquthela eQhubela Phambili ukuThintela, ukuLungela kunye nokuSabela kuBhubhani, kwisikhundla sakhe sobuNtshatsheli kuManyano lwama-Afrika ukuSabela kwiSifo seNtsholongwana i-Corona (i-COVID-19).

src: Lenaneo la Afrika Borwa la Tšhomišano ya Mebušo ya Dinaga leo le Bego le Sweratšwe ka Thoko Nakong ya UNGA ya bo Ka thokwana go UNGA ya bo 78, Mopresidente Ramaphosa o ile a eta pele kemedi ya mmušo yeo e ilego ya swara dikopano tša go fapafapana tša ditšhomišano tša mebušo ya dinaga tšeo di bego di nepile go matlafatšeng dikamano tša togamaano, sepolotiki le kgwebišano.
tgt: Inkqubo yamazwe amabini yoMzantsi Afrika esecaleni kwe-UNGA yama-7.

src: Mopresidente o ile a kopana le mong-ka-yena wa Ukraine, Mopresidente Volodymyr Zelensky go ahlaahla tšwelopele yeo e šetšego e le gona go magato a go aga boitshepo a Lesolo leo le Etilwego Pele ke Afrika, mmogo le ditšwelopele tše dingwe.
tgt: Ecaleni kwe-UNGA yama-78, uMongameli Ramaphosa ukhokele igqiza likarhulumente elibambe iintlanganiso ezininzi zamazwe amabini ezijolise ekuqiniseni ubudlelwane kubuchule, kwezopolitiko, kwezozakuzo kunye nakurhwebo.

src: Mopresidente Recep Tayyip Erdoğan wa Türkiye mabapi le go matlafatša dikamano magareng ga Afrika Borwa le Turkey, gape le go hlalosetšana ka masolo a khutšo mabapi le ntwa ya magareng ga Russia le Ukraine.
tgt: UMongameli udibene nogxa wakhe wase-Ukraine u-Volodymyr Zelensky ukuze baxoxe ngenkqubela phambili eyenziwayo kwiNyathelo lwase-Afrika loXolo - olukhokelwa ngamanyathelo okwakha ukuzithemba kunye nolunye uphuhliso.

src: Mopresidente Bola Tinubu wa Ripaboliki ya Federale ya Nigeria mabapi le go matlafatša dikamano magareng ga Afrika Borwa Le Nigeria.
tgt: Mongameli Recep Tayyip Erdoğan wase-Türkiye, malunga nokuqinisa ubudlelwane phakathi koMzantsi Afrika kunye ne-Turkey, kunye nokwazisana ngamaphulo oxolo kungquzulwano oluphakathi kwe-Russia ne-Ukraine.

src: O ile a fiwa gape le pego ya gabjale ya lesolo leo le etilwego pele la Economic Community of West African States la mabapi le go menola mmušo ka Niger mmogo le maitekelokakaretšo a go buša pušo ya demokrasi ka Sahel.
tgt: Mongameli Bola Tinubu we-Federal Republic of Nigeria, malunga nokuqinisa ubudlelwane phakathi koMzantsi Afrika kunye ne-Nigeria.

src: Mopresidente Emmerson Mnangagwa wa Ripaboliki ya Zimbabwe mabapi le masolo ka mmušo wa Zimbabwe a go kopantšha go agwa leswa ga naga yeo morago ga dikgetho tšeo di sa tšwago feta tša khutšo.
tgt: Uye wafumana ezihlaziyiweyo malunga nenyathelo loQoqosho lwaMazwe aseNtshona Afrika elikhokelwa lubhukuqo-mbuso e-Niger kunye neenzame ngokubanzi zokubuyisela ulawulo lwentando yesininzi e-Sahel.

src: Mopresidente Ramaphosa o kgathile tema gape le ka go Kopano ya Kgwebo Kgwebišano ya Afrika le Dipeeletšo ya United States (US) le Afrika Borwa, yeo e bego e akaretša baetapele ba kgwebo ba ka Afrika Borwa le ba ka Amerika.
tgt: Mongameli Emmerson Mnangagwa weRiphabhlikhi yaseZimbabwe, kumalinge karhulumente waseZimbabwe okuhlanganisa ukwakhiwa ngokutsha kwela lizwe emva kolonyulo olunemvisiswano lwakutsha nje.

src: Ka dikhamphani tša go feta tše 600 tšeo di šomelago ka Afrika Borwa, therišano ye e bile bohlokwa kudu go matlafatšo yeo e tšwelago pele ya dikamano magareng ga Afrika Borwa le UNakong ya kopano, tsebišo ya semmušo e ile ya dirwa ya gore Foramo ya Kgwebišano le Ekonomi ya US le Afrika ya ka Sub-Sahara (Foramo ya AGOA) ya bo 20 e tlo swarelwa Johannesburg go tloga ka la 2 go fihla ka la 4 Dibatsela 2023.
tgt: UMongameli Ramaphosa ukwathathe inxaxheba kwiNgxoxo yoShishino ngezoRhwebo kunye noTyalo-mali lweMelika (i-US) noMzantsi Afrika, equka iinkokeli zoshishino zaseMzantsi Afrika kunye nezaseMelika.

src: Foramo ye e tlo akaretša gape le pontšho ya ‘Made in Africa’ yeo e tlo bontšhago tšweletšo le tšhomišo ya didirišwa tša selete mo kontinenteng.
tgt: Ngeenkampani ezingaphezu kwama-600 zase-US ezisebenza eMzantsi Afrika, olu thethathethwano lwalubalulekile ekuqiniseni ubudlelwane phakathi koMzantsi Afrika kunye ne-UNgeli xesha, kwenziwa isaziso esisesikweni sokuba iForam yama-20 ye-US-Sub-Saharan Africa Trade and Economic Cooperation Forum, (iForam ye-AGOA) iza kubanjelwa eRhawutini ukusuka ngomhla wesi-2 ukuya kowesi-4 kweyeNkanga wama-2023.

src: Mopresidente Ramaphosa o ile bona le tsebišo ya tšhomišano magareng ga Novo Nordisk le Aspen.
tgt: Le foram iza kuphinda ibe nomboniso othi ‘Made in Africa Exhibition’ oza kubonisa amakhonkco ewonke eemveliso zommandla kwilizwekazi.

src: Tšhomišano ye e tlo bona tšweletšo ya insulini mafelong a Aspen a ka Gqeberha ka Kapa Leboa.
tgt: UMongameli Ramaphosa uphinde wangqina isibhengezo sentsebenziswano phakathi kwe-Novo Nordisk kunye ne-Aspen.

src: Tšhomišano ye e nepile go aba marothi a go feta dimilione tše 16 a insulini ka 2024, ao a tlo oketšwago pele ngwaga wa 2026 o fela.
tgt: Le ntsebenziswano iza kubona ukuveliswa kweyeza leswekile (i-insulin) kwiziko le-Aspen eGqeberha, eMpuma Koloni.

src: Se se tlo matlafatša kudu phihlelelo ya kalafo ya insulini, e sego ka Afrika Borwa fela, eupša le go phatlalala le kontinente.
tgt: Le ntsebenziswano ijolise ekuboneleleni ngamathamo eyeza leswekile angaphezulu kwe-16 lezigidi ngowama-2024, neza kunyuswa ngowama-2026.

src: Phihlelelo ye e bohlokwa ge go etla kaonafatšong ya bokgoni bja tšweletšo bakeng sa mararankodimagolo le go šogana le go diragala ga kgaotšo ya mohlagase.
tgt: Oku kuya kuphucula kakhulu ufikelelo kunyango lweswekile, kungapheleli nje eMzantsi Afrika, kodwa nakwilizwekazi liphela.

src: Kabinete e ile ya begelwa gape ka tšwelopele ya go bušetša Diyuniti 1, 2 le 3 tša Setiši sa Mohlagase sa Kusile gore di šome gape pele ga nako yeo e beilwego.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukunikwa koMlawuli wezaMandla weSizwe woMzantsi Afrika izicelo zempepha-mvume zokurhweba kunye nokungenisa/ukuthumela ngaphandle kwiNkampani yeSizwe yoThumelo lwezaMandla yoMzantsi Afrika, kuvulwa indlela yokuthengwa kwamandla kuwo wonke ummandla.

src: Kabinete e amogetše tekolo yeo e sa fetogego ya Eskom ka Moody’s Investors Service, yeo e tlo kaonafatšago boleng bja sekoloto bja khamphani ye ya mohlagase le go e kgontšha gore e itokiše e sa le nako ge go etla phethagatšong ya tlhokomelo yeo e beakantšwego go ditlabela tša yona tša tšweletšo.
tgt: Ukusebenza kwakhona kwesiKhululo soMbane saseKusile Yunithi yesi-4 kulungiso olucwangcisiweyo noluthe lwabuyisa iimegawathi ezingama-800 kuthungelwano lwethu lombane.

src: Tšhireletšo ya Meetse Kabinete e ile ya begelwa ka maitekelo a go šogana le ditlhohlo tša meetse tšeo di amago mafelo a mantšhi ka nageng.
tgt: Esi siganeko singundoqo ekuphuculeni umthamo wokuvelisa uthungelwano lwesizwe kunye nasekukhawulelaneni namaxesha okucinywa kombane.

src: Tona ya Meetse le Kelelatšhila, Morena Senzo Mchunu mmogo le bommeyaraphethiši ba ye mengwe ya mebasepala ya ka Gauteng ba tla tla ka pego ya dikimollo tšeo di tšwelago pele go dira gore kabo ya meetse e se šitišege ka profenseng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphinde yachazelwa ngenkqubela yokubuyisela iYunithi yoku-1, yesi-2 kunye neyesi-3 kwiSikhululo soMbane iKusile phambi kwexesha elimiselweyo.

src: Kabinete e rata go gopotša bohle gore Afrika Borwa ke naga yeo e hlaelago meetse.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamkele izinga elizinzileyo lika-Eskom elenziwe yi-Moody’s Investors Service, nto leyo eza kuphucula ukufaneleka kwetyala leli ziko lombane lize likwazi ukucwangcisa kwangaphambili ukuphumeza ulungiso olucetyiweyo lwezithuthi zalo zokuvelisa.

src: MaAfrika Borwa ka moka mmogo le batho bohle ka mo nageng ba swanetše ba boloke le go babalela meetse.
tgt: UMphathiswa wezaManzi noGutyulo, uMnu Senzo Mchunu kunye noosodolophu abalawulayo kwezinye zezixeko zaseRhawutini baza kubonelela ngohlaziyo longenelelo oluqhubekayo lokuzinzisa ukuhanjiswa kwamanzi kweli phondo.

src: Ditaba tša Kgwebišano Kopano ya Magoro a Ditona a Khomišene ya Dinaga tše Pedi tša Afrika Borwa le Lesotho (BNC) Kopano ya Magoro a Ditona a Khomišene ya Dinaga tše Pedi tša Afrika Borwa le Lesotho yeo e bego e swerwe go tloga ka la 25 go fihla ka la 28 Lewedi 2023 e beile šedi go tšhomišano ya ekonomi, mathata a ka mellwaneng ya dinaga tše, le go sepela ka go lokologa ga batho, dithoto le ditirelo magareng ga dinaga tše tše pedi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inqwenela ukukhumbuza wonke umntu ukuba uMzantsi Afrika lilizwe elinqongophelelwe ngamanzi.

src: Mopresidente Ramaphosa le Tonakgolo Samuel Ntsokoane Matekane ba tla ba badulasetulo mmogo ba Sešene ya Mathomo ya BNC magareng ga Afrika Borwa le Lesotho ka Labone la 28 Lewedi 2023.
tgt: Bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika kunye naye wonke umntu okweli lizwe kufuneka onge kwaye asebenzise amanzi ngononophelo.

src: BNC e tla akaretša dikamano tša botseta, sešole le tšhireletšo, meetse, dinamelwa, mohlagase le kgwebišano.
tgt: IKomishoni yeZizwe eziManyeneyo eziMbini yoMzantsi Afrikane-Lesotho (i-BNC) kunye neNtlanganiso yeQela laBaphathiswa.1 INtlanganiso ye-BNC yoMzantsi Afrika ne-Lesotho kunye neQela laBaphathiswa ebibanjwe ukusuka ngomhla wama-25 ukuya kowama-28 kweyoMsintsi 2023 igxile kwintsebenziswano yezoqoqosho, kwimiba yokuwela imida, kunye nokuhamba ngokukhululekileyo kwabantu, iimpahla neenkonzo phakathi kwala mazwe mabini.2 UMongameli Ramaphosa kunye neNkulumbuso u-Samuel Ntsokoane Matekane baza kujongana neSeshoni yokuQalwa kwe-BNC phakathi koMzantsi Afrika ne-Lesotho ngoLwesine, umhla wama-28 kweyoMsintsi 2023.

src: Nyakišišo ya Mebaraka go Polatefomo ya Namolo ya Inthanenteng Kabinete e amogetše pego go tšwa go Khomišene ya Phenkgišano ya mabapi le dihwetšwa mmogo le magato a kimollo go Nyakišišo ya Mebaraka go Polatefomo ya Namolo ya Inthanenteng.
tgt: I-BNC iza kubandakanya ubudlelwane kwezozakuzo, kukhuselo nokhuseleko, amanzi, ezothutho, umbane kunye nakwezorhwebo.2 UPhando lweNtengiso kwiQonga elikwi-Intanethi.1IKhabhinethi ifumene ingxelo evela kwiKomishoni yoKhuphiswano malunga neziphumo kunye namanyathelo okulungisa malunga noPhando lweNtengiso kwiQonga elikwi-Intanethi.

src: Kabinete e retile mošomo wa khomišene wa go šogana le dingongorego tša taolo ka botlalo ka dipolatefomong namolo tša ditšithale, go balwa le go reka le go rekiša inthaneteng, ditheo tša go rulaganya maeto tša inthaneteng, phihlišo ya dijo tša mabenkele, mabenkele a inthaneteng a di-app, baabi ba dipapatšo tše nnyane tša go bewa ka magoro le mananeo a go nyaka tshedimošo inthaneteng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iwuncomile umsebenzi wekhomishini ekujonganeni neenkxalabo kumaqonga edijithali, kubandakanywa urhwebo lwe-ecommerce, ii-arhente zokuhamba ezikwi-intanethi, ukuhanjiswa kokutya, iivenkile ze-app, ababoneleli abakhethiweyo kunye neenjini zokukhangela.2 IKhabhinethi iyalele abaPhathiswa bamasebe karhulumente achaphazelekayo ukuba aqhubele phambili athethathethane ngezindululo zokuphucula, baqwalasele iziphumo zomgaqo-nkqubo baze benze utshintsho oluyimfuneko kumgaqo-nkqubo, oluya kunceda abantu baseMzantsi Afrika ukuba bathathe inxaxheba ngokufanelekileyo kunye namashishini amancinci naphakathi kushishino olukhulayo olenziwa nge-intanethi.

src: Kabinete e laetše Ditona tša dikgoro tša mmušo tša maleba go tšwela pele go sekaseka ditigelo bakeng sa kaonafatšo, go ela hloko ditlamorago tša dipholisi gape le go tla ka diphetošo tšeo di hlokegago tša dipholisi tšeo di tlo nolofatšago kgathotema ya go kwagala mmogo le dikgwebo tše nnyane le tša magareng go kgwebo ya intaneteng yeo e golago.
tgt: Umkhuhlane weentaka IKhabhinethi iqaphele uqhambuko lwangoku loMkhuhlane obangela izifo (i-HPAI) H5 kunye ne-H7 kushishino lweenkukhu eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Mokhohlane wa Dinonyana Kabinete e lemogile go phulega ga mokhohlane o šoro kudu (HPAI) wa H5 le H7 ka indasetering ya dikgogo ka Afrika Borwa.
tgt: INtshona Koloni kunye neKwaZulu-Natal ziye zafumana ukuqhambuka kwe-HPAI H5 ngelixa i-HPAI H7 iye yachazwa kumaphondo iRhawutini, i-Limpopo, iMpumalanga kunye naseMntla Ntshona.

src: Magato a go laola go phatlalala ga bolwetši a gare a tšewa gomme balemi ba hlohleletšwa go latela magato a tšhireletšo ao a beilwego.
tgt: Amanyathelo okulawula ukusasazeka koku kuqhambuka akhona kwaye amafama ayakhuthazwa ukuba athathele ingqalelo amanyathelo amiselweyo okhuseleko lwendalo.

src: Go phulega mo go bea tšhireletšo ya dijo kotsing, gomme magato a kgwebišano ka mokgwa wa diromelwakagare go kgontšha go ba gona ga mae a go thwathwaša ditsuana, ao a lewago mmogo le nama ya kgogo a ka phethagatšwa.
tgt: Uqhambuko lubeka imingcipheko yokhuseleko lokutya kwaye amanyathelo orhwebo okungenisa elizweni ukuze kulawulwe ukufumaneka kwamaqanda kunye nenyama yenkukhu anokuphunyezwa.

src: Kgoro ya Temo, Peakanyoleswa ya Naga le Tlhabollo ya Dinagamagae, Setheotaolo sa Ditsweletšwa tša Maphelo sa Afrika Borwa le indaseteri di mekamekana le dikgopelo tša go ngwadišwa ga meento yeo e ka nyakegago, ka magato a tatelomolao ao a amanago le polokego, go phethagala mmogo le boleng ao a lego bohlokwa bakeng sa go ngwadišwa ga meento e bjalo.
tgt: ISebe lezoLimo, uHlengahlengiso loMhlaba noPhuhliso lwasemaPhandleni, uGunyaziwe woLawulo lweeMveliso zezeMpilo eMzantsi Afrika kunye noshishino baphonononga izicelo zokubhaliswa kwamayeza okugonya anokubakho, ezi namanyathelo okuthotyelwa kwezinto ezinxulumene nokhuseleko, ukusebenza kakuhle kunye nomgangatho zezona zinto zibalulekileyo ekubhalisweni kwezitofu zokugonya.

src: Ntwammogo kgahlanong le bosenyi Kabinete e amogetše pego ya mabapi le ntwa kgahlanong le bosenyi, yeo e aletšwego setšhaba ke Tona ya Maphodisa, Mogenerale Bheki Cele, le Setheo sa Bosetšhaba sa Tšhomišanommogo le tša Bohlodi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamkele ingxelo yakutsha yokulwa ulwaphulo-mthetho, nethe yanikwa isizwe nguMphathiswa wamaPolisa, uNjengele Bheki Cele, kunye neCandelo leSizwe lokuSebenza okuDityanelweyo nobuNtlola.

src: Lesolo le la go ba le ditheo tša go fapafapana leo le lebaganego le tša meepo yeo e sego molaong le bofaladi bjoo bo sego molaong ka Kapa Leboa le dirile gore batho ba 867 ba swarwe, gomme bontšhi bja bona ba tšwa Lesotho, Zimbabwe, Mozambique, mmogo le MaAfrika Borwa a mangwe.
tgt: Iphulo leendidi ngeendidi malunga nokombiwa kwemigodi ngokungekho mthethweni kunye nofuduko eMntla Koloni kukhokelele ekubanjweni kwabantu abangama-867, uninzi lwabo lusuka e-Lesotho, e-Zimbabwe, e-Mozambique kunye nabemi abathile boMzantsi Afrika.

src: Kabinete e ile ya boeletša polelo ka makala a phethagatšo ya molao ya gore MaAfrika Borwa ao a šireletšago basenyi bao ba dirago tša meepo yeo e sego molaong ba tla lebagana le letsogo la molao.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalise uluvo lwee-arhente zogcino-mthetho lokuba abemi boMzantsi Afrika abagcine abaphuli-mthetho ababandakanyeka kwizenzo zokombiwa kwemigodi ngokungekho mthethweni baya kujongana nengalo yomthetho.

src: Boso bja go Befa Mekgwa ya boso bja go befa bja ka mo nageng e laetša seabe seo phetogo ya klaemete e nago le sona maphelong a rena, mmogo le tlhokego ya magato ao a swarelelago a go fediša khapone ka ikonoming ya rena mola re le gare re lwela go ba le tlhabollo yeo e swarelelago.
tgt: Iimeko zemozulu ezimbi kakhulu zelizwe zigxininisa ifuthe lokutshintsha kwemozulu kubomi bethu kunye nesidingo sokuthatha amanyathelo azinzileyo okuphelisa ikhabhoni kuqoqosho lwethu ngelixa sizama uphuhliso oluzinzileyo.

src: Kabinete a gare a e tsebišwa ka masetlapelo ao a hlotšwego ke dipula tša matlakadibe le mafula ka Kapa Bohlabela, Kapa Bodikela le ka Gauteng, ka taetšo ya gore go na le kgonagalo ya gore se se ka fetela le ka diprofenseng tše dingwe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyaziswa ngomonakalo obangelwe zizaqhwithi ezimandla kunye nezikhukula ezise Mpuma Koloni, eNtshona Koloni kunye naseRhawutini, nto leyo ebonisa ukuba oku kunganwenwa nakwamanye amaphondo.3 IKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kuluntu ukuba luhlale luphaphile kwaye lujonge izilumkiso ezingakumbi zemozulu, nezinokuzisa umonakalo ongakumbi kwilizwe liphela.

src: Kabinete e ipiletša go ditšhaba gore di dule di ntšhitše mahlo dinameng bakeng sa ditemošo tša boso bja go befa tšeo di ka bago gona, tšeo di ka tlišago masetlapelo le go feta go phatlalala le naga.
tgt: Urhulumente usaqhubeka nokuxhasa iinkonzo zongxamiseko kunye namaziko olawulo lweentlekele ukulungiselela imisebenzi yokuhlangula kunye nokubonelela ngenkxaso kuluntu.

src: Mmušo o tšwela pele go thekga ditirelo tša tšhoganyetšo le disenthara tša taolo ya masetlapelo bakeng sa mošomo wa go hlakodiša gape le go fana ka thekgo ya setho.
tgt: I-Winnie Mandela Avenue IKhabhinethi ikuqaphele ukuthiywa ngokutsha kwe-William Nicol Drive e-Sandton ukuba ibe yi-Winnie Mandela Avenue njengenyathelo elibalulekileyo lokubhala ngokutsha imbali yoMzantsi Afrika ukuze ibonise igalelo labo babesilwela inkululeko yethu.

src: Winnie Mandela Avenue Kabinete e lemogile go rewa leswa ga Mmilamogolo wa William Nicol ka Sandton go ba Winnie Mandela Avenue bjalo ka kgato e bohlokwa ya go ngwala histori ya Afrika Borwa leswa go bonagatša seabe sa bao ba lwetšego tokologo ya rena.
tgt: Lo mnyhadala ubungqamene nomhla wokuzalwa kuka-Winnie Madikizela-Mandela ngomhla wama-26 kweyoMsintsi 2023.Izigqibo zeKhabhinethiISicwangciso-qhinga esiHlaziyiweyo seNyama yeeNyamakazi eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Tiragalo ye e ile ya lebana le letšatši la matswalo la Winnie Madikizela-Mandela fao nkabego a swere mengwaga ye 87 ka la 26 Lewedi 2023.Diphetho tša Kabinete Leano leo le Mpshafaditšwego la Nama ya Diphoofolo tša Naga Bakeng sa Afrika Borwa Kabinete e dumeletše go phethagatšwa ga Leano leo le Mpshafaditšwego la Nama ya Diphoofolo tša Naga bakeng sa Afrika Borwa, leo le nyakago go bea molaong mmogo le go fetoša indaseteri ya nama ya diphoofolo tša naga.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukuphunyezwa kwesiCwangciso-qhinga esiHlaziyiweyo seNyama yeeNyamakazi eMzantsi Afrika, esijonge ukumisela ngokusesikweni kunye nokuguqula ishishini lenyama yenyamakazi.

src: Leano le le nepile go matlafatša lekala la nama ya diphoofolo tša naga bjalo ka moabi wa polokego ya dijo le lekala leo le golago la ekonomi leo le ka thušago go hlola mešomo.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso-qhinga sijolise ekuqiniseni icandelo lenyama yenyamakazi njengomboneleli wokufumaneka kokutya kunye necandelo lohlumo kuqoqosho elinokunceda ekudaleni imisebenzi.

src: Afrika Borwa e maemong a pele kontinenteng ya Afrika ka tšweletšo ya nama ya diphoofolo tša naga.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika ubekwe kwindawo yokuqala kwilizwekazi i-Afrika ngenxa yemveliso yenyama yenyamakazi.

src: Leano le le nyaka go netefatša gore go hlolwa mešomo ye 202 666 yeo e swarelelago ka indasetering ya nama ya diphoofolo tša naga pele ngwaga wa 2023 o feta.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso-qhinga sijonge ukuqinisekisa ukudalwa kwemisebenzi engama-202 666 ezinzileyo kushishino lwenyama yenyamakazi ngowama-2030.

src: Leano le le tlo phatlalatšwa wepsaeteng ya Kgoro ya Dithokgwa, Boreahlapi le Tikologo: WEBTOKELeanolegolo la Lekala la Boeti Kabinete e dumeletše go beakanywa ga Leano la Tsošološo ya Lekala la Boeti go ba Leanolegolo le leswa la Boeti.
tgt: Isicwangciso-qhinga siya kupapashwa kwiwebhusayithi yeSebe lamaHlathi, ezokuLoba nokusiNgqongileyo ku: www.

src: Le tšwela pele go tla le ka leano la tsošološo ka botlalo ya boeti ka mo nageng.
tgt: IsiCwangciso esiPhambili seCandelo lezoKhenketho.

src: Le ge e le gore Leano la Tsošološo ya Lekala la Boeti le hlametšwe go nolofatša tsošološo ya lekala le, go lota mešomo le go šireletša lephelo, Leanolegolo le le tla tšea mošomo wo la o hlatlošetša maemong a godimo gape le go nolofatša menyetla ye meswa ka lekaleng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukulungelelaniswa kwesiCwangciso sokuBuyisela iCandelo lezoKhenketho kwisiCwangciso esiPhambili soKhenketho esitsha.

src: Leano le le šišinya maanokimollo a šupa go netefatša gore lekala la boeti le boela sekeng, gape le gore le ba modu wa tlholo ya mešomo le boipereki.
tgt: Inxalenye nebalulekileyo yesiCwangciso esiPhambili kukunciphisa iimpembelelo zobhubhani we-COVID-19 kwicandelo lezokhenketho.

src: Indaseteri ya boeti ke mokgathatema yo bohlokwa ka ekonoming gomme le be le thekga mešomo ye 725 000 pele ga go phulega ga leuba la COVID-19.Melaokakanywa Molaokakanywa wa Lekgotlakgašo la Afrika Borwa (SABC) wa 2023 Kabinete e dumeletše go išwa ga Molaokakanywa wa SABC wa 2023 Palamenteng.
tgt: Nangona iSicwangciso soBuyisela seCandelo lezoKhenketho saphuhliswa ukuququzelela ukuchacha ngcono kweli candelo, ukugcina imisebenzi kunye nokukhusela iindlela zokuphila, esi Sicwangciso siPhambili siya kuwuthatha lo msebenzi siwuse kwelinye inqanaba kwaye siququzelele amathuba amatsha kweli candelo.

src: Ge o se no fetišwa go ba Molao, Molaokakanywa wo o tla phumola Molao wa Kgašo woo o šomago gabjale wa 1999 (Molao wa bo 4 wa 1999).
tgt: Esi sicwangciso siphakamisa izicwangciso-qhinga zongenelelo ezisixhenxe ukuqinisekisa ukuba icandelo lezokhenketho libuyela kwiintsuku zalo zodumo, kwanokuba libe liziko lokudala imisebenzi kunye noshishino.

src: Diphetošo di tla matlafatša phethagalo ya mešomo ya kgašo ya setšhaba.
tgt: Ishishini lezokhenketho linegalelo elibalulekileyo kuqoqosho kwaye lalixhase imisebenzi engama-725 000 phambi kobhubhani we-COVID-19.

src: Molaokakanywa wo o tšwela pele go šišinya diphetogo ka seakong sa thekgo ya mašeleng sa SABC mmogo le mokgwa wa go bea dilaesense tša dithelebišene.
tgt: Imithetho eYilwayoUMthetho oYilwayo weQumrhu loSasazo laseMzantsi Afrika (i-SABC) wama-2023.

src: Molaokakanywaphetošwa woo o sa Thadilwego wa Ditirelo tša Meetse Kabinete e dumeletše go phatlalatšwa ga Molaokakanywaphetošwa wa Ditirelo tša Meetse gore setšhaba se fane ka ditshwayatshwayo go wona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukungeniswa ePalamente koMthetho oYilwayo we-SABC wama-2023.

src: Dinepokgolo tša Molaokakanywa wo ke go matlafatša go rwala maikarabelo bakeng sa baabi ba ditirelo tša meetse gape le go tsebagatša taba ya go šoma phatlalatša.
tgt: Wakuba upasisiwe ube ngumthetho, lo Mthetho uYilwayo uya kukhokelela ekurhoxisweni koMthetho woSasazo okhoyo ngoku, we-1999 (uMthetho wesi-4 we-1999).

src: Diphetošo tša Molao wa Ditirelo tša Meetse wa 1997, (Molao wa bo 108 wa 1997) di tla netefatša gore baabi ba ditirelo tša meetse ba aba meetse a boleng bja godimo bjalo ka karolo ya dipeelano tša dilaesense tša bona.
tgt: Ezi zihlomelo ziza kuqinisa ukusebenza kakuhle kosasazo loluntu.

src: Diphetošo tše di tlo šogana gape le mafokodi ao a hlathilwego ka lekaleng la ditirelo tša meetse.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo ukwaphakamisa iinguqu kwindlela yenkxaso-mali ye-SABC kunye nenkqubo yokukhutshwa kweelayisenisi zikamabonakude.

src: Molaokakanywa wo o bea melawana ya motheo bakeng sa baabi ba ditirelo tša meetse, yeo e swanetšego e phethagatšwe ke ditheotaolo tša Ditirelo tša Meetse.
tgt: UMthetho-siHlomelo oYilwayo weeNkonzo zaManzi.

src: Molaokakanywaphetošwa wa Meetse wa Bosetšhaba woo o sa Thadilwego Kabinete e dumeletše phatlalatšo ya Molaokakanywaphetošwa wa Meetse wa Bosetšhaba woo o sa Thadilwego gore setšhaba se fane ka ditshwayatshwayo go wona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukupapashwa koMthetho-siHlomelo oYilwayo weeNkonzo zaManzi ukuze uluntu luhlomle.

src: Diphetošo tše di tlo kaonafatša melawana gomme ebile di tlo netefatša gore methopo ya meetse ya ka nageng e laolwa gabotse, e a šireletšwa ebile e a lotwa.
tgt: Iinjongo eziphambili zalo Mthetho uYilwayo kukuqinisa ukuphendula kwababoneleli ngeenkonzo zamanzi kunye nokwazisa ukungafihlwa kwezinto.

src: Molaokakanywa wo o dira gape le ditšhišinyo tša go fediša go se lekalekane ga nako yeo e fetilego goo go amanago le kabo ya meetse, gomme o kgontšha mekgwa yeo e phethagetšego ebile ya ka pela ya tharollo ya mathata a ka gare ga ditheo ka moka.
tgt: Izihlomelo kuMthetho weeNkonzo zaManzi, wowe-1997 (uMthetho we-108 wowe-1997) ziza kuqinisekisa ukuba ababoneleli ngeenkonzo zamanzi bahambisa amanzi akumgangatho ophezulu njengenxalenye yemiqathango yabo yokufumana iimpepha-mvume.4Ezi zihlomelo ziza kujongana nobuthathaka obuthe bachongwa kwicandelo leenkonzo zamanzi.

src: Go Thwalwa Batho ka moka bao ba thwetšwego mešomong mangwalo a bona a dithuto a tla tiišetšwa le go netefatšwa ka maleba.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo ubeka imigangatho emincinane yokusebenza kwababoneleli ngeenkonzo zamanzi, nekufuneka inyanzeliswe ngabasemagunyeni beeNkonzo zaManzi.

src: Morena Sihle Ngubane bjalo ka Molaodipharephare: Taolo ya Mešomo go la Government Printing Works.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukupapashwa koMthetho-siHlomelo oYilwayo waManzi weSizwe ukuze uluntu luhlomle.

src: Go Thwalwa ga Balaodi bao e sego ba Phethišo go Boto ya Panka ya Tlhabollo ya Afrika Borwa Morena Bongani Nqwabana (thwaloleswa).
tgt: UMnu Kuberndran Moodley njengoMphathi Jikelele: Ukwenziwa kweMveliso nobuNjineli kwi-Government Printing Works.

src: Morena Petrus Matji (thwaloleswa).
tgt: UMnu Sihle Ngubane njengoMphathi Jikelele: uLawulo lweMisebenzi kwi-Government Printing Works.

src: Morena Jonathan Muthige.
tgt: UNksz Deshnie Subbiah kunye.

src: Mme Chantal Naidoo.
tgt: noMnu Jannie Venter.

src: Morena Joel Netshitenzhe Profesa Edgar Pieterse le.
tgt: UMnu Bongani Nqwabana (uqeshiwe kwakhona).

src: Go kgethwa ga Tona Motshekga go ba karolo ya phanele ya maemo a godimo go bonagatša maemo a gagwe a botsebi ka lekaleng la thuto, gape ebile ke taetšo ya boitshepo go tsela ya thuto ya Afrika Borwa.
tgt: INyanga yezoThutho yalo nyaka iza kukhunjulwa phantsi komxholo othi: “Siyakha - Sakha iziseko ezingundoqo ezingcono ukukhulisa uMzantsi Afrika”.

src: Phanele ye e akaretša baemedi go tšwa Mokgatlong wa Boditšhabatšhaba wa Bašomi, Sehlophatšhomo sa Barutiši sa Mokgatlo wa Thuto, Saense le Setšo wa Ditšhabakopano, Mekgatlo ya Barutiši ya Lefase, le ditona tše tharo tša thuto.
tgt: INyanga yezoThutho yowama-2023 iza kugxila kutyalo-mali olukhulu kwiziseko ezingundoqo zezothutho, kwaye ihlaba ikhwelo lokuba kukhuselwe iziseko ezingundoqo zezothutho kubusela kunye nasekonakalisweni.

src: Di-studio tša Difilimi tša Cape Town, baraloki ba selegae le badiragatši ba go tsaroga, ka mošomo wa bona lenaneong la Netflix la One Piece leo le bilego maemong a pele lefaseng ka bophara mo polatefomong ye ya go bogela ditiragatšo le difilimi inthaneteng.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika uza kujoyina ihlabathi liphela ekubhiyozeleni uSuku looTitshala lweHlabathi ngoLwesine, umhla wesi-5 kweyeDwarha 2023, phantsi komxholo othi: “Ootitshala esibadingayo kwimfundo esiyifunayo: Kunyanzelekile kwihlabathi jikelele ukunciphisa ukunqongophala kootitshala”.

src: Lefelo la Botitiedi la Van Ryn ge le filwe sefoka sa Porenti ye Kaonakaone lefaseng bakeng sa porenti ya bona ya mengwaga ye 12 Phadišanong ya Boditšhabatšhaba ya Digalagala go la London.
tgt: Olu suku lujolise ekukhuliseni ulwazi, ukuqonda kunye nokuxabisa igalelo elibaluleke kakhulu elenziwa ngootitshala kwimfundo nakuphuhliso kwihlabathi jikelele.

src: Matshidišo Kabinete e rometše matshidišo go ba malapa le bagwera ba:Morena Aziz Goolam Hoosein Pahad (82), molwelatokologo yoo a bilego Motlatšatona wa mathomo wa Merero ya Dinagadišele go tloga ka 1994 go fihla ka 2008.
tgt: Olu suku lubhengezwe ngokubambisene noMbutho weHlabathi wezaBasebenzi kunye noMbutho weZizwe eziManyeneyo wezeMfundo, ezeNzululwazi kunye neNkcubeko ukubhiyozela umsebenzi obalulekileyo owenziwa ngootitshala bethu.

src: Lieutenant Commander Gillian Elizabeth Hector, Master Warrant Officer William Masela Mathipa, le Warrant Officer Class One Mmokwapa Lucas Mojela, bao ba hlokofetšego ba le mošomong ba le ka gare ga sapomarini ya SAS Manthatisi ka ntle ga Kommetjie ka Kapa Bodikela.
tgt: ImiyalezoAmazwi okuvuyisanaIKhabhinethi idlulise amazwi okuvuyisana kunye neminqweno emihle kwaba:UNjengele Bheki Cele, uMphathiswa wamaPolisa, ofumene iMbasa ye-Great Wall Commemorative evela e-People’s Republic of China ngegalelo leNkonzo yamaPolisa oMzantsi Afrika kwintsebenziswano ebanzi yokuthotyelwa komthetho phakathi kwala mazwe mabini.

src: Bašomi ba moepo ba 22 go tšwa Moepong wa Ditaemane wa Venetia ka Limpopo, bao ba hlokofetšego kotsing ya tsela ka Musina (ka Seleteng sa Vhembe).
tgt: UNks Angie Motshekga, uMphathiswa weMfundo esiSiseko, ekukhethweni kwakhe nguNobhala-Jikelele we-UN, uMnu Antonio Guterres, ukuba asebenze kwi-Global High-Level Panel ukumcebisa ngendlela amazwe angaziguqula ngayo iinkqubo zawo zemfundo.

src: Merero ye Bohlokwa Seemong sa Bjale Bafenyi ba Sebjana sa Lefase sa Rakepiyi sa 2023 Kabinete e lebogišitše sehlopha sa Springboks ka phenyo ya sona ya Sebjana sa Lefase sa Rakepiyi sa 2023 yeo e dirilego gore Afrika Borwa e be naga e nnoši yeo e thopilego Sebjana sa Lefase sa Rakepiyi makga a mane (4) le go ba naga ya bobedi ya go thopa sefoka gabedi ka tatelano.
tgt: Imiba enguNdaba-mlonyeni IiNtshatsheli zeNdebe yoMhlaba yeBhola yoMbhoxo yama-2023 IKhabhinethi ivuyisene neqela lama-Springboks kwimpumelelo yalo yeNdebe yoMhlaba yeBhola yoMbhoxo yama-2023 eyenze ukuba uMzantsi Afrika ube lilizwe ekukuphela kwalo ukuphumelela iNdebe yoMhlaba yeBhola yoMbhoxo amaxesha amane (4) kunye nelesibini ukuyiphumelela amaxesha elandelelana.

src: Mo historing ya rakepiyi ka Afrika Borwa, sehlopha se sa Springboks ke se se fapaneng kudu go ya ka kemedi ya dipalopalo tša batho ba Afrika Borwa.
tgt: Kwimbali yebhola yombhoxo eMzantsi Afrika, eli qela le-Springboks lelona lineyantlukwano ngokwentlanga eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Tlhopho ya sehlopha se bjalo se se fapaneng e be e se tiro ya go itiragalela fela, eupša e be e le maitapišo a ka boomo a balaodi le bahlahli ba sehlopha sa Springboks go kgetha sehlopha seo se akaretšago bohle.
tgt: Ukwakhiwa kweqela elineyantlukwano enjalo ibingesosenzo sebhaqo, kodwa ibingumzamo wangabom wabaphathi kunye nabasebenzi abaqeqeshayo be-Springboks abaye bakhetha iqela eliquka zonke iintlanga.

src: Sephetho seo sa sebete sa mohlahli wa nako yeo Rassie Erasmus le sehlopha sa gagwe se tšwela pele go laetša Maafrika Borwa le lefase ka moka, gore mang le mang yo a nago le bokgoni, ge a ka fiwa sebaka le thekgo, a ka ba mogale – tiišetšo ya gore re ba le Maatla ge re le Mmogo.
tgt: Eso sigqibo sokuthatha umngcipheko somqeqeshi welo xesha u-Rassie Erasmus kunye neqela lakhe sisaqhuba ukubonisa abantu baseMzantsi Afrika kunye nehlabathi ngokubanzi, ukuba wonke umntu onesakhono, xa enikwe ithuba nenkxaso, angagqwesa – oku kusisiqiniseko sokuba soMelele xa Sikunye.

src: Sa bohlokwahlokwa, kgotlelelo le boikemišetšo bja sehlopha sa Springboks lepatlelong la dipapadi ke mohlala wa moya wa nnete wa go ba Moafrika Borwa, tšeo di dirago gore re be setšhaba se setee se segolo kgahlanong le ditšhitišo le mathata ka moka gore sehlopha se atlege go ba mofenyi.
tgt: Okubaluleke kakhulu, ukunyamezela kunye nokuzimisela kwe-Springboks kwibala lezemidlalo ngumfuziselo wokuba ngumNtu waseMzantsi Afrika wokwenene, oko okwenza ukuba esi sizwe sikhulu kangaka silwe noloyiso nangona sijongene neenzingo, ekugqibeleni siphume soyisile.

src: Ba bangwe ba dibapadi tše kaone tša sehlopha se sa Springboks ba ile ba swanelwa ke go fenya mathata a motho ka noši tseleng ya bona ya go ya bogolong.
tgt: Abathile kwabona badlali bagqwesileyo beli qela le-Springboks kuye kwafuneka endleleni yabo ebhekise empumelelweni boyise iinzingo zobomi babo.

src: Kabinete e lebogišitše Siyamthanda “Siya” Kolisi, mokapotene wa go thopa Sebjana sa Lefase gabedi sa Springboks ka go eta pele sehlopha gore se fihle maemong a go ba Dinkgwete tšeo di Dirilego Mošomo wa go Kgahliša (GOAT) gomme meketeko e swanetše go tšwela pele.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalise ukuvuyisana kwayo noSiyamthanda “Siya” Kolisi, ikapteni ebikhokele i-Springboks iqela eliphumelele iNdebe yeHlabathi kabini ngokulandelelana de labe lifikelela kwiwonga lokuba liqela eliphambili elake Laba liKhulu ngeXesha lalo i-Greatest of All Time (i-GOAT) mayiqhube ke imibhiyozo.

src: Foramo ya AGOA Kabinete e amogetše tiišetšo yeo e dirilwego bobedi ke mmušo wa Amerika le Palamente ya yona ka maikemišetšo a go oketša nako ya go šoma ga AGOA, yeo e fago babeeletši maatla ka dinageng tšeo AGOA e di šomelago.
tgt: I-Forum ye-AGOA IKhabhinethi isamkele isiqinisekiso esisuka kulawulo lwase-United States kunye nenkongolo esimalunga nenjongo yokolula i-AGOA, nto leyo izisa isiqinisekiso kuluntu lotyalomali kumazwe afanelekileyo ukuxhamla kwi-AGOKanajalo iKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukusingathwa kwe-forum ye-AGOA yama-2023 ebibanjelwe e-Johannesburg ngomhla we-2 ukuya mhla we-4 kweyeNkanga 2023 nebizinyaswe ngabathathi nxaxheba abavela kumazwe ase-Afrika angama-32 avela kurhulumente, uShishino, uluntu ngokubanzi kunye nabezemisebenzi ebebehambele lo msitho okokuqala kuquka kunye nabameli bakarhulumente wase-United States.

src: Kabinete e be e amogetše gape go swarwa ga Foramo ya AGOA ya 2023 ka Johannesburg go tloga ka la 2 – 4 Dibatsela 2023 ka bakgathatema ba go tšwa dinageng tše 32 tša Afrika go tšwa mmušong, Kgwebong, setšhabeng sa badudi le bašoming lekga la mathomo le baemedi ba mmušo wa Amerika.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isoloko ikuqinisekisa ukuba i-AGOA ibonelela i-United States of America ngethuba lokomeleza ubudlelwane bayo bezoqoqosho ne-Afrika yiloo nto ke kufuneka le AGOA yolulwe ukuze ibenethuba eloneleyo lokuthela iziqhamo, kwaye yenziwe luqilima ukuze ibe neempembelelo ezintle kananjalo ibenawo nomtsalane.

src: Kabinete e be e dutše e tiišetša gore AGOA e fa Amerika sebaka sa go matlafatša kamano ya yona ya ikonomi le Afrika gomme ka go realo e swanetše go oketša nako ya go šoma ga AGOA ka nako ya go bonagala, go e dira gore e be le khuetšo le go goga šedi.
tgt: INtlanganiso yobaPhathiswa bezoKhenketho be-BRICS IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukuqukunjelwa ngempumelelo kweNtlanganiso yabaPhathiswa bezoKhenketho be-BRICS yama-2023 ebibanjelwe eKapa, apho amazwe angamalungu azibophelele kwintsebenziswano enzulu kunye nasekukhuthazeni ukhenketho phakathi kwi-BRICS, ukuphuhlisa iindlela zokuhamba nonxulumano phakathi kwamazwe angamalungu.

src: Kopano ya Ditona tša Boeti tša BRICS Kabinete e amogetše go fihla mafelelong ka katlego ga Kopano ya Ditona tša Boeti ya BRICS ya 2023 yeo e swerwego ka Motsekapa, yeo e tlamilego ditšhabamaloko go tšhomišano ye e tseneletšego le go tšwetša pele boeti bja ka gare ga BRICS, go hlabolla ditsela tša go kaonafatša maeto a boeti le kgokagano magareng ga dinagamaloko.
tgt: Oku kuza komeleza nangakumbi icandelo lezokhenketho laseMzantsi Afrika esele libonisa iimpawu zokuvuka ke noko.

src: Dikgweding tše 8 tša mathomo tša 2023, baeti ba dimilione tše ba tsene ka gare ga naga bao ba emetšego koketšego ya 63.4% go tloga nakong ye e swanago ka 2022.
tgt: Kwiinyanga ezisi-8 zokuqala zika-2023, ilizwe lamkele i-5.5 yezigidi zabantu abafikayo oko okubonakalise ukonyuka ngama-63.4% xa kuthelekiswa neli thuba linye lango-2022.

src: 4.Boingwadišo bja Bakgethi IEC e tsebišitše letšatšikgwedi la 18 le la 19 Dibatsela 2023 bjalo ka mafelelo a beke a mathomo a boingwadišo bja bakgethi ba Dikgetho tša Kakaretšo tša 2024.
tgt: UkuBhalisela ukuVota I-IEC yabhengeza umhla we-18 nowe-19 kweyeNkanga 2023 njengempelaveki yokuqala yokubhalisela ukuvota kuNyulo Jikelele luka-2024.

src: Kabinete e ipiletša go bakgethi ka moka bao ba nago le maswanedi go ingwadišetša go kgetha go Dikgetho tša Kakaretšo tša 2024 diteišeneng tša go kgetha tša kgauswi le bona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema bonke abavoti abafanelekileyo ukuba babhalisele ukuvota kuNyulo Jikelele luka-2024 kwizikhululo zokuvota ezikufutshane nabo.

src: Boingwadišo bja bakgethi bja inthanete bo buletšwe go tloga ka Dibokwane 2023 gomme badudi ba hlohleletšwa go šomiša inthanete go ingwadiša goba go mpshafatša dintlha tša bona.
tgt: Ukubhalisela ukuvota nge-intanethi kuvulwe ukususela ngeyoMdumba wama-2023 kwaye abemi bayabongozwa ukuba basebenzise esi sibonelelo ukubhalisa okanye ukuhlaziya iinkcukacha zabo.

src: Maafrika Borwa ao a dirilego dikgopelo tša di-ID a hlohleletšwa go etela ofisi ya tikologo ya gabo bona ya Merero ya Selegae go di tšea.
tgt: Abantu baseMzantsi Afrika abafake izicelo zabo zee-ID bayakhuthazwa ukuba bazilande ngokuthi batyelele i-Ofisi yeSebe leMicimbi yezeKhaya.

src: Go na le disematekhathe tša ID tša go feta 500 000 tšeo di sa ntšego di swanetše go tšewa dikantorong tša Merero ya Selegae go ralala le naga.
tgt: Angaphezulu kwama-500 000 amakhadi ee-ID ekusafuneka ukuba ayolandwa kwii-ofisi zeSebe leMicimbi yezeKhaya elizweni ngokubanzi.

src: Mohlagase Tona ka Kantorong ya Mopresidente yeo e rwelego maikarabelo a Mohlagase o file tshedimošo ye e feletšego ka ga maemo a mohlagase ka nageng.
tgt: Umbane UMphathiswa kwi-Ofisi kaMongameli onoxanduva lokujonga imicimbi yezoMbane unike amagqabantshintshi abanzi ngemeko yombane elizweni.

src: Kabinete e retile maitapišo a Mmušo wa Profense ya Gauteng wo o šomišanago le Eskom go bušetša mohlagase mafelong a Gauteng ao a hlasetšwego ke go tima ga mohlagase ka lebaka la bohodu goba tshenyo ya ditransefoma.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iziqhwabele izandla iinzame zikaRhulumente wePhondo lase-Gauteng zokusebenza ne-Eskom ukubuyisela umbane kwimimandla yase-Gauteng ebithwaxwa kukucima kombane ngenxa yokwebiwa okanye umonakalo kwizixhobo ezihambisa amandla ombane.

src: Maabane bošego, ditransefoma tše tshela tše mpsha tša mohlagase di tšhumilwe go la Kagiso, tikologong ya West Rand morago ga gore ditšhaba di dule di se na mohlagase mengwaga ya go feta ye Kabinete e ipiletša go ditšhaba tše go šireletša mananeokgoparara a bohlokwa go bohodu, tshenyo ya ka boomo le tshenyo yeo e hlolwago ke dikgokagano tšeo di sego molaong.
tgt: Izolo ebusuku, kuye kwalayitwa izixhobo ezihambisa amandla ombane ezithandathu eKagiso, kummandla weNtshona Randi emva kokuba uluntu lwashiyeka lungenambane isithuba esingaphezulu kweminyaka emithathu.

src: Mpholo wa Dijo Kabinete e tshwenyegile ka go ata ga go ja ga bana mpholo wa dijo ka lebaka la go ja dijo tšeo di fetilwego ke nako le tšeo di šilafetšego go tšwa mabenkeleng a diphaza le barekišing ba mebileng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema olu luntu ukuba luzikhusele iziseko zophuhliso ezibalulekileyo ekwebiweni, ekonakalisweni kunye nomonakalo obangelwa luqhagamshelo olungekho mthethweni.

src: Kabinete e hlohleletšwa ke maitapišo a phethagatšo ya molao go gapeletša tatelo ya polokego ya dijo.
tgt: UkuTyhefeka kokuTya IKhabhinethi ixhalabile yindlela ekonyuke ngayo iziganeko zabantwana abatya ityhefu ngenxa yokutya ukutya okuphelelwe lixesha kunye nokutya okungcolisekileyo kwasespaza kunye nokwabathengisi basesitalatweni.

src: Tlhahlo ya Maemo a Boditšhabatšhaba ya Bomeyara le Magoši ka Bofaladi Kabinete e tsebišitšwe ka ga Tlhahlo ya Maemo a Boditšhabatšhaba ya Bomeyara le Magoši ka Bofaladi yeo e swerwego ke Kgoro ya Merero ya Selegae ka go kgatha tema ga Kgoro ya Tlhabollo ya Dikgwebopotlana, Kgoro ya Pušotirišano le Merero ya Setšo, Kgoro ya Bodulo bja Batho kamoka le magoši le bomeyara go tšwa mebasepaleng ya dimetro le ya dilete bao ba bego ba lebeletše kudu go thibela ditlamorago tša bofaladi bjo bo sego molaong, go akaretšwa le ditshepedišo tša mabenkele a diphaza.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhuthazwa ziinzame ezenziwa ngabanyanzelisi bomthetho zokunyanzelisa ukuthotyelwa kokhuseleko ekutyeni.

src: Dipoelo tše bohlokwa di akaretša go tsebagatšwa ga melawana ye mmalwa go rarolla ditlhohlo tše di amanago le phethagatšo ya melawana ya kgwebo ke mebasepala le balaodi ba setšo.
tgt: INtlanganiso yeeNgxoxo nooSodolophu kunye neenkokeli zeMveli ngeMfuduko yeHlabathi IKhabhinethi yanikwa amagqabantshintshi malunga nentlanganiso yeengxoxo ngemfuduko yehlabathi eyayisingethwe liSebe leMicimbi yezeKhaya ngothatho nxaxheba lwe-DSBD, i-COGTA, iSebe leeNdawo zokuHlaliswa kwabaNtu kunye neenkokeli zemveli noosodolophu abavela koomasipala abambhaxa kunye nabezithili eyayijolise ekunqandeni iziphumo zemfuduko engekho mthethweni, kuquka noshishino lwezipaza.

src: Go tla ba le ditlhahlobo tša mohlakanelwa tša ka pela tša dikgwebo, kudukudu mabenkele a diphaza ka dikgoro tša bašomi, maphelo, tlhabollo ya dikgwebopotlana le dihlopha tša bahlahlobi ba bofaladi ba Merero ya Selegae, go bona gore melao ye e amegago e a latelwa.
tgt: Iziphumo ezingundoqo ziquka ukwaziswa kwemithetho equka konke kamasipala ukuze ithathele ingqalelo imingeni enxulumene nokunyanzeliswa kokusetyenziswa kwemithetho yendawo inyanzeliswa ngoomasipala kunye nabasemagunyeni kulawulo lwemveli.

src: Go tla dirwa tekolo ya mabenkele a diphaza ka metseng le ditoropong, le mekgwa ya go a ngwadiša bobedi ka baetapele ba setšo le mebasepala.
tgt: Kuza kubakho uhlolo nophando olukhawulezileyo oluza kuqhutywa ngokuhlanganyelweyo lokujonga ukusetyenziswa kwemithetho yamashishini, ingakumbi izipaza lisebe lezemisebenzi, elezempilo, elophuhliso lwamashishini amancinci kunye namaqela ahlola imfuduko eSebe leMicimbi yezeKhaya, ukunyanzelisa ukuthotyelwa kwemithetho elindelekileyo kumashishini.

src: Gape go na le maitapišo a go thekga balaodi ba setšo gore ba boloke rekoto ya badudi ba dinagadišele ditšhabeng tša bona.
tgt: Ukuphicothwa kwezipaza ezilalini nasezilokishini, kunye neendlela zokuzibhalisa ezingasetyenziswa ziinkokeli zemveli kunye noomasipala nako kuza kwenziwa.

src: Molao wa dilaesense tša kgwebo o a fetošwa go thekga bohle bao ba ratago go gweba ka lekaleng leo e sego la semmušo.
tgt: Kukwakho neenzame zokuxhasa oogunyaziwe bemveli ukuba bagcine uluhlu lwamagama abemi bangaphandle kwiindawo abahlala kuzo.

src: Twantšho ya Bosenyi ye e Kopanetšwego Kabinete e retile SAPS ka go šwalalanya segongwana sa boditšhabatšhaba sa diokobatši ka morago ga go hwetšwa ga khokheine ya boleng bja R80 milione yeo e thopilwego ka la 20 Diphalane 2023 ka lefelong la polokelo ka Boemakepeng bja Kgwebišano bja Dube ka gare ga Boemafofane bja Boditšhabatšhaba bja King Shaka.
tgt: Kulungiswa umthetho wokunikwa kwelayisenisi kumashishini ngelo kuxhasa bonke abo banqwenela ukurhweba kwicandelo lweshishini elingekho sikweni.

src: Matšatši a mabedi pele ga se, khokheine ye nngwe ya boleng bja R70 milione le yona e thopilwe ka gare ga khontheina Boemakepeng bja Durban.
tgt: UMlo woLwaphulomthetho oHlanganyelweyo IKhabhinethi iyincomile i-SAPS ngokufumana iqela elithubelezisa iziyobisi kumazwe angaphandle kulandela ukufunyanwa kwe-cocaine exabisa ama-R80 ezigidi ebanjwe ngowama-20 kweyeDwarha 2023 kumzi wokugcina impahla i-Dube Trade Port kwisikhululo seenqwelomoya i-King Shaka International Airport.

src: Kabinete e reta SAPS ka mošomo wa bona wa go šitiša le go šwalalanya bosenyi bjo bo rulagantšwego bja boditšhabatšhaba bjo bo beago badudi le naga kotsing ye kgolo.
tgt: Kwiintsuku ezimbini eziphambi koku, kubanjwe enye i-cocaine exabisa ama-R70 ezigidi kwiZibuko laseThekwini.

src: Lesolo la Sehla sa Matswalo a Morena se se Bolokegilego le šetše le tšweletša dipoelo ka maphodisa ao a golegilego bagononelwa ba go feta 140, go akaretšwa le dintona tša meepo yeo go thwego ga e molaong, le go thopa dithunya tšeo di se nago mangwalo a tumelelo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyiqhwabela izandla i-SAPS ngomsebenzi wayo ekuphazamiseni kunye nasekunqandeni ulwaphulomthetho oluququzelelweyo lwamazwe amaninzi olusisigrogriso esikhulu kwiindawo zethu esihlala kuzo nakwisizwe siphela.

src: 9.Ketelo ya Tekolo ya Mopresidente Kabinete e amogetše Ketelo ya Tekolo ya Mopresidente go Mmasepala wa Emfuleni, yeo e latetšego ditšhomišano le setšhaba nakong ya ketelo ya Mmotlolo wa Tlhabollo ya Selete wa 2022.
tgt: IPhulo le-Operation Safer Festive Season sele liveza iziphumo ngamapolisa abambe ngaphezulu kwe-140 yabarhanelwa, kuquka norhanelwa ngokuba ngungqondongqondo ekumbiweni kwemigodi okungekho mthethweni, kunye nokuthathwa kwemipu engenazilayisenisi.

src: Ketelo ya 2022 ya Emfuleni e lemogile ditaba tša tlhokomelo ye mpe ya mananeokgoparara ka masepala.
tgt: UTyelelo lukaMongameli lokuyoKhangela Ukuqhubekeka koMsebenzi IKhabhinethi ilwamkele uTyelelo lukaMongameli lokuyoKhangela Ukuqhubekeka koMsebenzi kuMasipala wase-Emfuleni, obelulandelela ukujonga iziphumo zothetha-thethwano zendibano noluntu elalibanjwe ngo-2022 kwiNkqubo yoPhuhliso lweZithili.

src: Ka tsenogare ya Kgoro ya Meetse le Kelelatšhila, go bile le kgatelopele ye e lemogegago ka go rarolla ditlhohlo tša mananeokgoparara a meetse le tlhwekišo tšeo di feleleditšego ka go phuhlama ga tshepedišo ya Meetse a Ditšhila a Vaal.
tgt: Utyelelo luka-2022 Emfuleni lwachonga imiba yokungalungiswa kakuhle kweziseko zophuhliso ngumasipala.

src: Go dirilwe mošomo wa go kaonafatša kabo ya meetse, go šoma gabotse ga mananeokgoparara a meetse a ditšhila gomme ka go realo go fediša bothata bja meetse a ditšhila ao a sepelago a kitima mebileng le dijarateng tša batho.
tgt: Ngongenelelo lweSebe lezaManzi noGutyulo, kube khona inkqubela ebonakalayo ekuthatheleni ingqalelo imingeni yeziseko zophuhliso zamanzi nezogutyulo ekhokelele ekuweni kwenkqubo ye-Vaal Waste Water.

src: Kgatelopele ye e lemogilwego nakong ya ketelo ye e akaretša dikaonafatšo tša diphaephe tše bohlokwa tša bontši le diteišene tša dipompo tša meetse, go tšweletšwa gape le go tswalelwa gape ga ditsela, le thakgolo ye kgolo ya mabone a setarateng go kaonafatša mabone le polokego.
tgt: Sowuqalile umsebenzi wokuphukcula unikezelo lwamanzi, ukusebenza ngokufanelekileyo kweziseko zophuhliso zamanzi amdaka kwaye oko kuphelisa ingxaki yemibhobho ehambisa amanzi amdaka ebesele egxagxaza ezitalatweni nakwiiyadi zabantu.

src: Mmapatsela wa Mokgwa wa Dithulaganyo tša Merwalo ka Afrika Borwa Kgoro ya Dinamelwa e thomile ditherišano ka ga Mmapatsela wa Mokgwa wa Dithulaganyo tša Merwalo ka Afrika Borwa, bjalo ka karolo ya magato a go rarolla ditlhohlo tšeo di lebanego le lekala la go rwala merwalo le dithulaganyo le go matlafatša maitapišo a go tsošološa ikonomi ya Afrika Borwa.
tgt: Inkqubela eqatshelweyo kolu tyelelo iquka uphuculo kwimibhobho yamanzi emininzi kunye nakwizikhululo zeempompo zamanzi, ukulungiswa ngaphezulu kunye nokutywinwa kweendlela, kunye nokufakwa ngobuninzi kwezibane zasesitalatweni ngelokuphucula ukukhanya nokhuseleko.

src: Tlhabollo ya Mananeokgoparara le Tlhokomelo Kabinete e amogetše kgatelopele ye e dirwago ka tlhabollo ya mananeokgoparara le tlhokomelo ka go phethwa ga maporogo a dinagamagaeng a 36 ka fase ga Maporogo a Dinagamagae a Welisizwe, le kago ye e tšwelago pele ka diprotšekeng tše 20 ka mafelong a bodulo a batho, ditsela, le meetse.
tgt: ISicwangciso seNkqubo yoThutho lweMpahla eMzantsi Afrika ISebe lezoThutho liqalise iindibano kwiSicwangciso seNkqubo yoThutho lweMpahla eMzantsi Afrika, njengenxenye yamanyathelo okuthathela ingqalelo imingeni ejongene necandelo lokuthuthwa kwempahla kunye nokomelezwa kweenzame zokubuyiselwa koqoqosho eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Thakgololeswa ya Ditsela tša Boditšhabatšhaba tša South African Airways (SAA) Kabinete e amogetše thakgololeswa ya ditsela tša boditšhabatšhaba tša SAA ka go tsebagatšwa leswa ga sefofane sa yona go kgabaganya dikontinente go ya São Paulo, Brazil, seo gape se swayago go boya ga tirelo ya leeto le letelele go tšwa Motsekapa le Johannesburg.
tgt: UPhuhliso nokuGcinwa kweziSeko zoPhuhliso IKhabhinethi iyamkele inkqubela eyenziweyo ngophuhliso kunye nokugcinwa kweziseko zophuhliso ngokugqitywa kweebhulorho zasezilalini ezingama-36 phantsi kwenkqubo yeWelisizwe Rural Bridges, kunye nokwakhiwa okuqalayo kweeprojekthi ezingama-20 kwiindawo zokuhlaliswa kwabantu, iindlela, namanzi.

src: Go boya ga SAA ka ditseleng tša boditšhabatšhaba go tla tsenya letsogo thwii go hlohleletša kgolo ya maeto a boditšhabatšhaba go ya ka nageng, le kgolo ya lefapha la boeti morago ga masetlapelo a leuba la COVID-19.
tgt: UkuPhehlelelwa ngokuTsha kweendlela zehlabathi zeQumrhu leeNqwelomoya loMzantsi Afrika (i-SAA) IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukuphehlelelwa ngokutsha kweendlela zehlabathi ze-SAA ngokubuyiswa ngokutsha kwehambo yayo yenqwelomoya ehamba phakathi kwamazwekazi eya e-São Paulo, e-Brazil, ephawule kananjalo ukubuya kwenkonzo ehamba ihambo ende esuka eKapa nase-Johannesburg.

src: Afrika Borwa e Thakgola Troune ye Kgolokgolo mo Afrika Kabinete e lebogišitše khamphani ya Tšhireletšo le ya sefofane ya Milkor ka go tsebagatšwa ga bona ka katlego ya sefofane sa eriale ya go se sepetšwe sa Milkor 380 (UAV), seo se beago Afrika Borwa gare ga dinaga tšeo di tšwelago pele go dira dikgatelopele ka theknolotšing ya ditroune.
tgt: Ukubuyela kwe-SAA kwiindlela zehlabathi kuza kufaka isandla ngqo ekuqhubeni ukukhula kokusetyenziswa kwezithuthi ezihamba kweli lizwe, kunye nokukhula kwecandelo lezokhenketho emva kokuba ligqugqiswe ngubhubhane we-COVID-19.

src: Milkor 380 ke troune ye kgolo yeo e agilwego ka Afrika gomme e tla šomišwa ke intasteri ya tšhireletšo go lwa, taolo ya mellwane, maitapišo a pabalelo go akaretšwa go lwantšha go tsoma ka tsela ye e sego molaong.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika uphehlelela eyona drone inkulu e-Afrika IKhabhinethi ivuyisene noMkhosi kunye nenkampani yobuchwepheshe bokubhabha emoyeni kweenqwelomoya i-Milkor ngokuphehlelela kwabo ngempumelelo i-Milkor 380 okusisithuthi esizihambelayo emoyeni (i-UAV), oku kubeka uMzantsi Afrika phakathi kwamazwe aqhubayo ukwenza imitsi emide kubuchwepheshe beenqwelomoya ezizihambela emoyeni ii-drone.

src: Ditlhahlobo tša Dikolo tša Mphato wa Marematlou le tša Mafelelo a Ngwaga Kabinete e amogetše go thoma ka thelelo ga ditlhahlobo tša Setifikeitisegolo sa Bosetšhaba (marematlou) tša 2023, tšeo di thomilego ka la 30 Diphalane 2023.
tgt: I-Milkor 380 yeyona drone inkulu eyakhiwe e-Afrika kwaye iza kusetyenziswa licandelo lezokhuselo ngeenjongo zokulwa, ulawulo lomda, ulondolozo lwendalo kuquka nokulwa ukuzingela okungekho mthethweni.

src: Batswadi le bahlokomedi ba hlohleletšwa go tšwela pele go thekga baithuti mo nakong ye ye bohlokwa.
tgt: Iimviwo zeMatriki kunye nezokuphela konyaka ezikolweni IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukuqala kakuhle kweemviwo zeSatifiketi esiPhezulu seSizwe (iMatriki) zama-2023, eziqale ngowama-30 kweyeDwarha 2023.

src: Kabinete e romela gape dikeletšo tša yona tše botse go baithuti ka moka bao ba tlago dula ditlhahlobong tša
tgt: Abazali nabagcini babantwana bayakhuthazwa ukuba baqhubeleke nokuxhasa abafundi ngeli xesha libaluleke kangaka.

src: Diphetho tša Kabinete Maemo a Palestina Kabinete e nyamišitšwe ke go gana ga mmušo wa Israele go hlompha molao wa boditšhabatšhaba le go tšwela pele ga wona go nyenyefatša diphetho tša Ditšhabakopano tša phethagatšo ya peo ya marumo fase ntle le kotlo.
tgt: Izigqibo zeKhabhinethi IMeko yase-Palestine Idanile iKhabhinethi kukwala kukarhulumente wakwaSirayeli ukuthobela umthetho wehlabathi kunye nokuqhubeka kwayo ijongela phantsi izigqibo zeZizwe eziManyeneyo zigqibo ezo ezifuna kubekwe phantsi izikhali ngaphandle kokohlwaywa.

src: Ditsela tša thušo ya botho go batho ba Palestina di sa tswaletšwe ka ditlamorago tše šoro go bana, basadi le badudi bao ba se nago molato.
tgt: Iindlela zokunika uncedo kubantu base-Palestine zisavaliwe kuza neziphumo ezimbi ebantwaneni, abasetyhini nabemi abangenatyala.

src: Ditlhaselo tša difofane tša polao ya molokwanarite ke mmušo wa Israele go batho ba Palestina, di tšwela pele ka go hlatloga ga palo ya mahu ao a akaretšago basadi le bana.
tgt: Uhlaselo lwasemoyeni olubulala abantu ngobuninzi olwenziwa ngurhulumente wakwaSirayeli ebantwini base-Palestine, luyaqhuba lubonakala ngamanani okusweleka kwabantu anyukayo aquka abasetyhini nabantwana.

src: Matšatšing a mabedi a go feta, lefase le dutše le se na thušo gomme la lebelela ge ditlhaselo tša difofane tšeo di gateletšago Gaza le West Bank di sentše dikolo, mafelo a maphelo, diampulensi le mananeokgoparara a setšhaba le ditsela tšeo go thwego di bolokegile tšeo di sepelago ka Borwa bja Gaza.
tgt: Kwiintsuku ezimbini ezidlulileyo, ihlabathi liye lahlala lijongile nje kungekhonto linokuyenza, njengoko uhlaselo lwasemoyeni olonyukayo lwase-Gaza nase-West Bank lutshabalalise izikolo, izibonelelo zempilo, iinqwelo zezigulane neziseko zophuhliso zabantu kunye nezo ndlela kuthiwa zikhuselekile eziya kuMzantsi we-Gaza.

src: Go tše, Kabinete e tšeere sephetho sa go gopotša badiplomate ka moka ba Afrika Borwa go tšwa Tel Aviv gore ba boledišane.
tgt: Ngenxa yoku, iKhabhinethi igqibe ekubeni ibuyise bonke oonozakuzaku baseMzantsi Afrika abase-Tel Aviv ukuze kudityanwe nabo.

src: Kabinete e lemogile gape ka go tshwenyega dipolelo tše di tšwelago pele tša go nyatša tša motseta wa Israele ka Afrika Borwa, Morena Eliav Belotsercovsky, kgahlanong le Maafrika Borwa, boetapele bja Afrika Borwa ka gare le ka ntle ga mmušo go akaretšwa le setšhaba sa badudi bao ba bolelago kgahlanong le polao ya setšhaba yeo e dirwago ke Mmušo wa Israele kgahlanong le Mapalestina.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iziqaphele kananjalo ngokukhathazeka izimvo ezinyhatshayo ezenziwa ngunozakuzaku wakwaSirayeli eMzantsi Afrika, uMnu Eliav Belotsercovsky, ezibhekisele kubantu baseMzantsi Afrika, ubunkokeli baseMzantsi Afrika kuquka uluntu ekuhlaleni oluthetha phandle ngokubulawa ngobuninzi kwabantu okwenziwa ngurhulumente wakwaSirayeli ebantwini base-Palestine.

src: Dipolelo tša go nyatša tša Moemedi Belotsercovsky di fapanywa ke dipolelo tša batseta ba babedi ba peleng ba Israele ka Afrika Borwa (Illan Baruch le Dr. Alon Liel) bao ba bego ba sa fetoge go hlaloša ditiro tša mmušo wa bona kgahlanong le Mapalestina bjalo ka Kgethollo.
tgt: Ezi zimvo zinyhatshayo zikaNozakuzaku Belotsercovsky ziyaphikiswa ziingxelo zabo babengoonozakuzaku bakwaSirayeli eMzantsi Afrika ababini (u-Illan Baruch noGqr Alon Liel) abo babengangungqi ekuchazeni izenzo zikarhulumente wabo ezichasene nabantu base-Palestine njengezenzo zengcindezelo.

src: Dipolelo tše di nyenyefatšago kgahlanong le bao ba bolelago kgahlanong le ditiro tše sehlogo le baetapele ba naga di dira gore maemo a motseta Belotsercovsky a se kgotlelelege le go feta.
tgt: Izimvo ezinyhatshayo ezibhekiswe kwabo bathethela phandle kunye nakwiinkokeli zelizwe zenza isikhundla sikanozakuzaku Belotsercovsky singakhuseleki okanye angafumani khuseleko.

src: Ka ge go le bjalo Kabinete e laetše Kgoro ya Dikamano tša Boditšhabatšhaba le Tirišano go fetišetša ka dikanale tša bodiplomate molaetša wa semmušo wa mmušo wa Afrika Borwa wa go se thabele maitshwaro a motseta.
tgt: Ke ngoko iKhabhinethi iyalele iSebe lezobuDlelwane beHlabathi neNtsebenziswano ukuba livakalise ukungoneliseki kukarhulumente waseMzantsi Afrika ngalo nozakuzaku oko kuzakwenziwa kulandelwa amajelo ozakuzo afanelekileyo.

src: Setatamente sa Pholisi ya Tekanyetšo ya Lebaka la Magareng Kabinete e amogetše Setatamente sa Pholisi ya Tekanyetšo ya Lebaka la Magareng (MTBPS) sa 2023, seo se filego kelo ya go se pepetletše ya maemo a bjale a ikonomi le go laetša go swara ga mmušo ka go tia ditšhelete tša setšhaba sa rena gare ga dithibelo tše thata tša letseno.
tgt: INgxelo yoMgaqonkqubo woHlahlo Lwabiwomali leXesha eliPhakathi IKhabhinethi iyamkele iNgxelo yoMgaqonkqubo yoHlahlo Lwabiwomali yeXesha eliPhakathi (i-MTBPS) yama-2023, enike uvavanyo olucacileyo lwemo yezoqoqosho ekhoyo ngoku kwaye yabonisa ukugcinwa kakuhle kwemali yethu yelizwe ngurhulumente nangona ephakathi kwemiqobo enzima.

src: Diphetho tšeo di lego ka go MTBPS di kaonafatša tlhako ya rena ya ditšhelete di hlohleletša kgolo ya ikonomi mola re lekalekanya maitlamo a rena a leago ao a thekgago bao ba lego kotsing setšhabeng sa rena.
tgt: Izigqibo ezikwi-MTBPS ziphucula inkqubosikhokelo yethu yezemali zivuselela ukukhula koqoqosho ngexa ingqinelanisa izibophelelo zethu zasekuhlaleni ezixhasa abo basesichengeni elizweni lethu.

src: Leano la Kagoleswa le Tsošološo ya Ikonomi le bile le seabe go mahlogedi a matala ikonoming ya rena.
tgt: ISicwangciso soKwakha ngokuTsha eMva kweNtlekele sibe negalelo kwiimpawu zokuqala zokuphucuka kuqoqosho lwethu.

src: Go Agwa ga Ditimela tša Lebelo le Legolo Kabinete e dumeletše Tlhako ya Go Agwa ga Ditimela tša Lebelo le Legolo gomme go tla ahlaahlwa ditšhelete tša go phethagatša mošomo magareng ga Tona ya Dinamelwa le ya Ditšhelete.
tgt: UPhuhliso loMzila wooLoliwe abaHamba ngeSantya esiPhezulu IKhabhinethi ivume iNkqubosikhokelo yoPhuhliso loMzila wooLoliwe abaHamba ngeSantya esiPhezulu kwaye iimpembelelo zemali ekuphunyezweni koku kuza kuxoxwa ngazo phakathi kwabaPhathiswa owezoThutho nowezeMali.

src: Kabinete e dumeletše go fa šedi ya pele tsela ya Johannesburg go ya Durban bakeng sa nyakišišo ya kgonagalo ye e tletšego, gomme Johannesburg-Polokwane go ya Musina, le Johannesburg go ya Mbombela di tla bewa mmarakeng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume ukubekwa phambili komzila osuka e-Johannesburg uya eThekwini ngophononongo olucazululiweyo loko kunokwenzeka, kwaye osuka e-Johannesburg nase-Polokwane uya eMusina, kunye nosuka e-Johannesburg uya eMbombela ziza kubekwa emarikeni.

src: Sethalwa sa Sengwalwa ka ga Boagi, Bofaladi le Tšhireletšo ya Bafaladi Kabinete e dumeletše phatlalatšo ya Sethalwa sa Sengwalwa ka ga Boagi, Bofaladi le Tšhireletšo ya Bafaladi bakeng sa ditshwayotshwayo tša setšhaba.
tgt: IPhepha leNgcaciso-Nkqubo eliQulunqwayo ngoBumi, iMfuduko kunye noKhuselo lweeMbacu IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukupapashwa kwePhepha leNgcaciso-Nkqubo ngoBumi, iMfuduko kunye noKhuselo lweeMbacu ukuze ulunike izimvo uluntu.

src: Sengwalwa sa Pholisi se ikemišeditše go fa tlhako ya go hlahla kabo ya bodulo le boagi go badudi ba dinaga tša ka ntle, gammogo le tšhireletšo ya bafaladi le bakgopedi ba botšhabelo ka Afrika Borwa, go lemoga dikgahlego tša tšhireletšo ya bosetšhaba tša Repabliki le go obamela ditumelelano tša boditšhabatšhaba le diprothokhole ka ga khudugo yeo Afrika Borwa e lego mokgahlo go yona.
tgt: UMgaqonkqubo oqulunqwayo ujolise ekunikeni inkqubosikhokelo yokukhokela ekunikweni kobuhlali nobumi kubemi bamazwe angaphandle, ngokunjalo nokukhuselwa kwembacu kunye nabafuni gwiba eMzantsi Afrika, kuthathelwa ingqalelo okubalulekileyo kukhuselo lwesizwe lweRiphabliki kunye nokuthotyelwa kwezivumelwano neeprotokoli zehlabathi ekufudukeni ezo uyinxenye yazo uMzantsi Afrika.

src: Pego ya Kgatelopele ya Ngwaga le Ngwaga ya bo 6 ka ga phethagatšo ya Sethalwa sa Sengwalwa sa Ditokelo tša Batho ba go Phela ka Bogolofadi Kabinete e dumeletše go phatlalatšwa ka kuranteng ya mmušo Pego ya Kgatelopele ya Ngwaga ka Ngwaga ya bo 6 ka ga phethagatšo ya Sethalwa sa Sengwalwa sa Ditokelo tša Batho ba go Phela ka Bogolofadi.
tgt: INgxelo yeNkqubela yoNyaka yesi-6 ngokuphunyezwa kwePhepha leNgcaciso-Nkqubo ngamaLungelo abaNtu abanokuKhubazeka

src: Kgatišo ya pego ya kgatelopele e tla sepelelana le segopotšo sa boditšhabatšhaba sa Kgwedi ya Temošo ya Ditokelo tša Bogolofadi go tloga ka la 3 Dibatsela go fihla ka la 3 Manthole.
tgt: .IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukupapashwa kwigazethi karhulumente kweNgxelo yeNkqubela yoNyaka yesi-6 ngokuphunyezwa kwePhepha leNgcaciso-Nkqubo ngamaLungelo abaNtu abanokuKhubazeka.

src: Pego ya kgatelopele e laetša gape koketšego ya nepišo ya tekatekano ya mešomo ya fasefase go tloga go 2% go ya go 3% go batho bao ba golofetšego go tloga ngwageng wa ditšhelete wa 2024/2025, go ya go nepišo ya bonnyane bja 7% ya tekatekano ya mešomo go batho bao ba golofetšego ka 2030.
tgt: Ukupapashwa kwengxelo yenkqubela kuza kudibana nokukhunjulwa kwihlabathi kweNyanga yokuQondwa kwamaLungelo okuba nokuKhubazeka ukusukela ngowe-3 kweyeNkanga ukuya kowe-3 kweyoMnga.

src: Melaokakanywa Sethalwa sa Molaokakanywa wa Sekhwama sa Tsošološo ya Afrika le Tirišano ya Boditšhabatšhaba (ARF) Kabinete e dumeletše go romelwa ga Molaokakanywaphetošo wa ARF Palamenteng.
tgt: Ingxelo yenkqubela ikhombisa kananjalo ukonyuka kujoliso lolingano lobuncinane bengqesho ukusuka kwi-2% ukuya kwi-3% ebantwini abanokukhubazeka ukusukela kunyakamali ka-2024/2025, ngokubhekisele kubuncinane be-7% yojoliso lolingano kwingqesho ebantwini abanokukhubazeka ngowama-2030.

src: Molaokakanywa wo o nyaka go fetoša Molao wa ARF (Molao wa 51 wa 2000) le go hloma Setheo sa Selekane sa Tlhabollo ya Afrika Borwa, seo se tlago šoma bjalo ka mokgwa wa go thekga tlhabollo le tirišano ya Afrika Borwa le dinaga tša baagišane ka tšwetšopele ya temokrasi, taolo ye botse, thibelo le tharollo ya phapang, tlhabollo ya ikonomi ya leago le kopanyo.
tgt: ImiThetho eYilwayo UmThetho oYilwayo weNgxowamali yokuZalwa ngokuTsha kwe-Afrika kunye neNtsebenziswano (i-ARF) IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukungeniswa komThetho oYilwayo oTshintshiweyo we-ARF ePalamente.

src: Go thwalwa mošomong ka moka di laolwa ke kgonthišo ya mangwalo a thuto le tumelelo ya maleba.
tgt: Abaqeshiweyo Zonke izikhundla zixhomekeke ekuqinisekisweni kwamabakala ezemfundo kunye nokuqinisekiswa okufanelekileyo kwezokhuselo Ukuqeshwa kukaMnu.

src: Go thwalwa ga Morena Ebrahim Rasool bjalo ka Modulasetulo wa Panka ya Tlhabollo ya Borwa bja Afrika.
tgt: Ebrahim Rasool njengoSihlalo weBhanki yoPhuhliso yamaZantsi e-Afrika.

src: Go thwalwa ga Mohumagadi Margaret Mosibudi Phiri bjalo ka leloko la Boto ya Bosetšhaba ya Taolo ya Nyutlelia
tgt: Ukuqeshwa kukaNks.

src: Ditiragalo tše di Tlago Poledišano ka Twantšho ya Bomenetša Poledišano ya Twantšho ya Bomenetša e tla swarwa ka la 8 le la 9 Dibatsela 2023 kua Birchwood Hotel ka Ekurhuleni go kgoboketša setšhaba go lwantšha bomenetša go sepelelana le Leano la Bosetšhaba la Twantšho ya Bomenetša la naga.
tgt: Margaret Mosibudi Phiri njengelungu le-National Nuclear Regulator Board.

src: Kabinete, ka Dibatsela 2020, e dumeletše Leano la Bosetšhaba la Twantšho ya Bomenetša (NACS 2020-2030).
tgt: IMisitho Ezayo INgxoxo emayelana nokuLwa noRhwaphilizo INgxoxo emayelana nokuLwa noRhwaphilizo iza kubanjwa ngowe-8 nowe-9 kweyeNkanga 2023 kwiHotele i-Birchwood Ekurhuleni ukuhlanganisa uluntu kumlo ochasene norhwaphilizo ngokungqinelana neSicwangciso esiLwa uRhwaphilizo seSizwe.

src: Lesolo la Matšatši a 16 a Boikgafo bja go Lwantšha Dikgaruru tša Twantšho ya Basadi le Bana la 2023 Ngwageng wo o swaya segopotšo sa bo 25 sa go tšea karolo ga Afrika Borwa mo Lesolong la Matšatšing a 16 a Boikgafo bja go Lwantšha Dikgaruru tša Twantšho ya Basadi le Bana la 2023 leo le tlago hlokomelwa ka fase ga morero: “Go akgofiša magato a go fediša dikgaruru le dipolao tša basadi (GBVF): go sa tlogelwe motho morago”.
tgt: IKhabhinethi, ngeyeNkanga 2020, yasivuma iSicwangciso esiLwa uRhwaphilizo seSizwe (i-NACS 2020-2030).

src: Lesolo le la lefase ka bophara le thoma ka la 25 Dibatsela, Letšatši la Boditšhabatšhaba la go Fediša Dikgaruru tša Twantšho ya Basadi go fihla ka la 10 Manthole, Letšatši la Boditšhabatšhaba la Ditokelo tša Botho.
tgt: Esi sisicwangciso selizwe esijolise ekudaleni indawo yoluntu engenalo urhwaphilizo ngexa kananjalo sikhuthaza abemi ukuba bangalunyamezeli kwaphela urhwaphilizo kwaye bathobele ulawulo lomthetho.

src: Lesolo le le ikemišeditše go lwantšha dikgaruru tša twantšho ya basadi mola le thekga ditokelo tša botho.
tgt: IiNtsuku ezili-16 zePhulo lobuTshantliziyo lokuChasa ubuNdlobongela obuBhekiswe kwabaseTyhini nabaNtwana lika-2023 Lo nyaka uphawula isikhumbuzo seminyaka engama-25 sothatho nxaxheba loMzantsi Afrika kwiiNtsuku ezili-16 zePhulo lobuTshantliziyo ekuChaseni ubuNdlobongela obubhekiswe kwabaseTyhini nabaNtwana eliza kuqwalaselwa phantsi komxholo: “Ukukhawulezisa amanyathelo okuphelisa ubuNdlobongela obuSekelwe kwiSini nokuBulawa kwabaseTyhini (i-GBVF): Kungashiywa mntu emva”.

src: Foramo ya bo14 ya Poledišano ya Pholisi Afrika Borwa mmogo le Sehlopha sa Boditšhabatšhaba sa Mošomo wa Barutiši sa Thuto (TTF) sa UNESCO ba tla swara Foramo ya bo14 ya Poledišano ya Pholisi ka Pherekgong 2024 ka fase ga morero wa “Go rarolla tlhaelelo ya barutiši le go dira gore profešene ye e kgahliše kudu”.
tgt: Eli phulo lehlabathi liqhuba ukusukela kowama-25 kweyeNkanga, uSuku lweHlabathi lokuPheliswa kobuNdlobongela obuBhekiswe kwabaseTyhini ukuya kowe-10 kweyoMnga, uSuku lwamaLungelo oluNtu lweHlabathi.

src: Foramo e tla kopanya bahlankedi ba mmušo, mekgatlo ye e sego ya mmušo, barutiši le ditsebi tša thuto go ahlaahla ditaba tše bohlokwa tšeo di lebanego le maemo a tirelo go barutiši, ditaba tša boipušo bja barutiši le boikarabelo gammogo le ka fao go ka dirago gore borutiši e be profešene ye e kgahlišago.
tgt: Lijolise ekulweni ubundlobongela obubhekiswe kwabasetyhini ngexa lisagcine amalungelo oluntu.

src: Sehlopha sa Proteas ka go hwetša maemo go makgaolakgang a Sebjana sa Lefase sa ICC sa 2023 ka India.
tgt: IQonga leNgxoxo yoMgaqosiseko ye-14 UMzantsi Afrika uza kusingatha iQonga leNgxoxo yoMgaqosiseko ye-14 idibene noMsebenzi oWenziwa ngooTitshala kwiMfundo weHlabathi (i-TTF) we-UNESCO ngeyoMqungu ka-2024 phantsi komxholo “Ukuthathela ingqalelo ukunqongophala kootitshala kunye nokuwenza ube nomtsalane ngakumbi umsebenzi lo”.

src: Le ge se lahlegetšwe papading ya bona kgahlanong le India maabane, naga e dula e le ka morago ga sehlopha ka maatla gomme e na le tshepho ya gore ba tla tšwela pele go phošolla diphošo le go dira gore re ikgantšhe ka sona.
tgt: Iqonga liza kuhlanganisa kunye amagosa karhulumente, ii-NGO, ootitshala kunye nengcali zemfundo ukuxoxa ngemiba ebalulekileyo ephathelene neemeko zengqesho kootitshala, imiba yokuzimela nokuthatha uxanduva kootitshala ngokunjalo nendlela yokwenza ube nomtsalane umsebenzi wokufundisa.

src: Naletšana ya mabelo a Moto GP Brad Binder yo bjale e lego moswari wa rekoto ya sefala sa sehlopha sa maemo a godimo ka go lebanya bakeng sa Afrika Borwa ka morago ga go fetša ga gagwe tše tharo tša godimo ka Thailand Grand Prix.
tgt: Ii-Proteas ngokuzifumanela indawo kwimidlalo eyandulela eyokugqibela kwindebe yeHlabathi ye-ICC ka-2023 e-Indiya.

src: Moagi wa mathomo wa Afrika Borwa wa go šomiša setulo sa bagolofadi Macethandile Kulati, ka go šireletša sefoka sa gagwe ka 2023 sa go ba nkgwete ya meraloko ya Mokgatlo wa Boditšhabatšhaba wa Baraloki ba go Kuka Ditšhipi ba Lefase le ba Boitekanelo ba go Aga Mmele ka Slovenia.
tgt: Nangona zingakhange ziphumelele kumdlalo wazo ne-Indiya izolo, ilizwe lisahleli libaxhasa ngamandla kwaye linethemba lokuba ziza kuqhuba ukwakha kwaye zisenze sibe nebhongo.

src: Diakhaontente tše di Hlomilwego tša Afrika Borwa ka go hwetša maemo a godimo nyakišišong ya lefase ka bophara ya ditshepetšo tša profešenale ya Edelman.
tgt: Umqhubi wemoto yomdyarho ye-Moto GP u-Brad Binder waseMzantsi Afrika ngoku onerekhodi yodidi oluphezulu kwiphodiyam emva kokugqiba kwakhe ephezulu ekwindawo yesithathu kuMdyarho weeMoto wase-Thailand.

src: Ngaka Claude Mashego ka go thopa Sefoka sa Mohumagatšana wa Lefase wa mathomo wa Afrika Borwa gomme bjale o tla emela Afrika Borwa Difokeng tša Mohumagatšana wa Lefase ka New Delhi, India ka Manthole ngwageng wo.
tgt: USozinyama wokuqala ohamba ngesitulo esinamavili waseMzantsi Afrika u-Macethandile Kulati ngokukhusela isitsaba sakhe kwiQumrhu leHlabathi looSozinyama leHlabathi kunye nobuNtshatsheli ekuziLolongeni kwiHlabathi ngo-2023 e-Slovenia.

src: Atebokheite Kholeka Gcaleka ka morago ga go thwalwa ga gagwe bjalo ka Mošireletši yo moswa wa Setšhaba lebaka la mengwaga ye šupa go thoma ka la 1 Dibatsela 2023.
tgt: I-South African Chartered Accountants ngokufumana isikhundla esiphezulu kuphando lwehlabathi lokwenza umsebenzi ngokwethembeka olwenziwe yi-Edelman.

src: Mofenyi wa sefoka sa gauta sa Bagolofadi Zanele Situ yo e bilego moatlelete wa mathomo wa mosadi wa mothomoso wa Afrika Borwa yo a thopilego sefoka sa gauta Dipapading tša Bagolofadi kua Sydney ka 2000.
tgt: UGqr Claude Mashego ngokuphumelela ukhuphiswano lokuba nguNkosazana Mzantsi Afrika okokuqala kwaye ke ngoku uza kumela uMzantsi Afrika kuNkosazana Mzantsi Afrika kwiNkosazana yeHlabathi e-New Delhi, e-Indiya ngeyoMnga kulo nyaka.

src: Mothuši wa peleng wa mohlahli wa Bafana-Bafana le naletsana ya kgwele ya maoto Phil “Mr Jones” Setshedi.
tgt: UGqwetha Kholeka Gcaleka kulandela ukuqeshwa kwakhe njengoMkhuseli woluNtu omtsha ixesha leminyaka esixhenxe ukuqala ngowe-1 kweyeNkanga 2023.

src: Mowaranteofisa Sthembiso Mazibuko wa Yuniti ya Tsenogare ya Bosetšhaba yo a bolailwego nakong ya go thuntšhana le disenyi ka Ntuzuma, KwaZulu-Natal.
tgt: Amazwi Ovelwano IKhabhinethi ivakalise uvelwano kusapho nabahlobo baba: Lowo wafumana imbasa yegolide kwii-olimpiki zaba nokukhubazeka uZanele Situ owaba yi-atleti yasetyhini emnyama yokuqala yaseMzantsi Afrika ukuphumelela imbasa yegolide kwiMidlalo yabanokuKhubazeka e-Sydney ngowama-2000.
